ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: checkout-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 12:42 UTC)
Alerting service: checkout
Alert time: 2026-07-02T12:42:00Z
Data available from 2026-07-02T11:00:00Z to 2026-07-02T14:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 7 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-02T13:00:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-07-02T12:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check error_rate_pct trend for checkout service to see the magnitude and exact timing of the spike.)
  Result: M-014: Change detected at 2026-07-02T12:40:00Z: mean 0.39 before, 18.04 after (204.9 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-014] checkout.error_rate_pct from 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z to 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z (13 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.2 max=18.21 mean=7.18 last=17.99; mean=7.18. Change detected at 2026-07-02T12:40:00Z: mean 0.39 before, 18.04 after (204.9 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-07-02T12:25:00Z = 0.2 (lowest); 2026-07-02T12:40:00Z = 18.05 (first point after the change); 2026-07-02T12:55:00Z = 18.21 (peak); 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z = 17.99 (last).
Step 2: log_search {"end": "2026-07-02T12:45:00Z", "level": "ERROR", "limit": 30, "query": "error,exception,fail", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-07-02T12:35:00Z"} (asked because: Search error logs in checkout service around the alert time to identify the specific failure mode.)
  Result: 1 matching log lines.
  [L-0289] 2026-07-02T12:43:52Z checkout ERROR request failed status=502 path=/api/v1/pay request_id=req-812c0b88
Step 3: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-02T13:00:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-02T12:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if the payments service also has a spike in error rate, which would confirm a downstream dependency issue.)
  Result: M-041: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-041] payments.error_rate_pct from 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z to 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z (13 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.2 max=0.76 mean=0.43 last=0.64; mean=0.43. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-07-02T12:05:00Z = 0.2 (lowest); 2026-07-02T12:10:00Z = 0.76 (peak); 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z = 0.64 (last).
Step 4: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-02T13:00:00Z", "metric": "restarts", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-07-02T12:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if checkout service restarted recently, which could indicate a bad deployment or OOM kill.)
  Result: M-018: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-018] checkout.restarts from 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z to 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z (13 points, 5-minute steps): min=0 max=0 mean=0 last=0; mean=0. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z = 0 (lowest); 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z = 0 (peak); 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z = 0 (last).
Step 5: log_search {"end": "2026-07-02T12:45:00Z", "limit": 30, "query": "pay,timeout,gateway,502", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-07-02T12:35:00Z"} (asked because: Search for payment or gateway related logs in checkout to see why /api/v1/pay returns 502.)
  Result: 3 matching log lines.
  [L-0278] 2026-07-02T12:41:21Z checkout ERROR upstream returned 503 for /api/v1/pay request_id=req-7d2d9d80
  [L-0285] 2026-07-02T12:43:05Z checkout ERROR upstream returned 503 for /api/v1/pay request_id=req-ca32bde3
  [L-0289] 2026-07-02T12:43:52Z checkout ERROR request failed status=502 path=/api/v1/pay request_id=req-812c0b88
Step 6: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-02T13:00:00Z", "metric": "latency_p99_ms", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-07-02T12:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check checkout latency to see if requests are timing out.)
  Result: M-015: Change detected at 2026-07-02T12:25:00Z: mean 258.83 before, 3261.99 after (237.3 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-015] checkout.latency_p99_ms from 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z to 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z (13 points, 5-minute steps): min=240.71 max=5623.12 mean=2106.93 last=5623.12; mean=2106.93. Change detected at 2026-07-02T12:25:00Z: mean 258.83 before, 3261.99 after (237.3 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-07-02T12:05:00Z = 240.71 (lowest); 2026-07-02T12:25:00Z = 922.67 (first point after the change); 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z = 5623.12 (last); 2026-07-02T13:00:00Z = 5623.12 (peak).
Step 7: runbook_retrieve {"k": 3, "query": "upstream dependency timeout and 503 errors handling and mitigation"} (asked because: Retrieve runbook guidance for downstream timeouts to recommend proper mitigation steps.)
  Result: 3 runbook sections; best match R-13-8 (match score 7.9).
  [R-13-8] DNS resolution failures - Related runbooks (match score 7.9): If connections work but replies are slow, use the downstream dependency timeout runbook. If requests are turned away because healthy servers are overloaded, use the traffic spike runbook instead of this one.
  [R-12-5] Database connection leak audit - Mitigation (match score 4.4): Fix the code path that leaks and make sure connections are always closed, for example with automatic resource handling. This is a development task, not an incident response. If there is an active outage, restart instances and use the pool exhaustion runbook.
  [R-03-5] Slow query or missing index - Mitigation (match score 3.9): Recreate the missing index using a concurrent build so writes are not blocked, then refresh the table statistics. As a stopgap, cancel the long-running queries and add a statement timeout. Revert the migration that removed the index if one is found.

Previous hypotheses:
- downstream_timeout: Logs show checkout service receiving upstream 503 errors and failing with 502 on the /api/v1/pay endpoint, alongside a massive spike in p99 latency. (evidence: M-014, M-015, L-0278, L-0285, L-0289)
- bad_deployment: A sharp increase in error rate and latency at 12:40 UTC could still be caused by a recent bad deployment introducing failures when calling upstream dependencies. (evidence: M-014, M-015)
